info.title: 知序 API
info.description: Cookie/session authentication with CSRF protection. ADMIN is required for /api/admin/**. USER may read and ask AI. Single backend instance. GET /api/questions returns summaries; load full answers through /api/questions/{id}. Legacy learning/import endpoints remain supported. Never point write tests at a business database.
